text.p: German City Estates NV (GCE), the Amsterdam quoted property company, announced an improved operational result of 6.3 million guilders versus 5.8 million guilders in 1995.
The operational result per share rose to 1.60 guilders in 1996 from 1.46 guilders in 1995 and the investment result per share was 3.47 guilders negative versus 5.82 guilders negative.
Net asset value per share before dividend 1996 fell by 6 percent to 38.11 guilders per share as a result of further falls in value of the German porfolio.
New property acquisitions of 113.6 million guilders in the Netherlands, Germany and Luxembourg helped increase gross assets by over 50 percent to 292.5 million guilders.
The Company took adventage of the very favourable interest rate climate and increased external debt from 25 percent to 53 percent of Investments.
Rental income for the year increased by 15 percent to 13.5 million guilders.
In a full year, the current portfolio would produce rental income of 16.5 million guilders.
The Board is to recommend the option of an increased cash dividend of 0.90 guilders per share versus 0.80 guilders in 1995.
